description: "Catalina advances her PostDoc academic journey working at the  Université de Lorraine  ERPI and LRGP laboratories, collaborating closely with Dr.J.M.Pearce at Western University's FAST laboratory. Her project aims to transform multi-material plastic waste into feedstock for large-scale 3D printing while enhancing material properties and compatibility through the addition of compatibilizers. Catalina believes in the power of innovation to shape a more sustainable and inclusive future by creating open-source technological solutions that benefit society and the environment."

I work at the [Équipe de Recherche sur le Processus Innovatifs --ERPI--](https://erpi.univ-lorraine.fr/) and teach at the [École Nationale Supérieure en Génie des Systèmes et de l'Innovation --ENSGSI--](https://ensgsi.univ-lorraine.fr/nos-formations/) at Nancy - France.

My research is developed at the [Lorraine Fab Living Lab](https://lf2l.fr/) on projects related to the concept of [**Distributed Recycling via Additive Manufacturing (DRAM)**](/publications/articles/2020-04-15-fabio/index.html). for circular economy perspectives valuing the junction between *open source* tools, social innovation spaces, holistic indicators. 
I hope this research contributes to way to put in place sustainability approaches for a post-growth scenarios.


[Learn more about my research &rarr;](/about){.about-links .subtitle}
